title: 8 Rules a Godly Man Sets for His Money
caption:
8 rules a godly man sets for his money before it sets them for him.

Give first. Know your number. Wait 48 hours. Let one brother see the statement.

Money is a master or a tool. Which one is yours right now?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #money #stewardship #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
